propositions: attach_commits rejects valid code commit SHAs when REBAR_TRACKER_DIR relocates ticket storage outside the code checkout because code_root_for derives the code repository from dirname(tracker) instead of resolving it independently

code_root_for and unresolvable_shas must be deleted after refactoring commit validation to use explicit repo_root (config.repo_root), REBAR_ROOT, or cwd Git top-level while preserving tracker reads/writes through REBAR_TRACKER_DIR
A real-git held-out regression test with independently relocated ticket store must observe RED before repair (valid commit rejected) and GREEN after repair (valid commit accepted)
Unknown/invalid commit SHAs must remain all-or-nothing rejections without partial COMMITS event recording, and default in-repo tracker behavior must be unchanged

The exact tracker-parent mutation (reverting to dirname(tracker)) must return the held-out test to RED, and repository search must confirm no remaining production definitions or references to code_root_for or unresolvable_shas
